name: atlassian-browser-mcp
description: Wraps mcp-atlassian with a Playwright browser-cookie login, so its Jira and Confluence tools work on Atlassian Server/Data Center behind corporate SSO (Okta, SAML) where API tokens are not available. Install: clone and `uv pip install -e .`, then `./atlassian-cli login jira` once per service · [Docs](https://github.com/GeiserX/atlassian-browser-mcp/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md)
